pains: Yaar, trip pe sabne alag-alag jagah pay kiya, ab hisaab karne mein hi dimaag kharab ho jaata hai.
Mai har baar paise maangne wala 'bad guy' ban jaata hoon, so awkward lagta hai.
Rent aur bijli ka bill split karna matlab Notes app mein calculation aur phir bhi koi na koi bhool jaata hai.
WhatsApp group mein hisaab daalo toh scroll karte karte sab dab jaata hai, kisi ko yaad hi nahi kitna dena hai.
Dost bolta hai 'kal de dunga' aur woh kal kabhi aata hi nahi.
desires: Bas ek jagah sab dikhe ki kisko kitna dena hai, no confusion.
Koi mujhe baar-baar yaad dilaye bina, paise apne aap wapas aa jayein.
Dosto se paise maangna bina awkward hue, app hi reminder bhej de.
Trip khatam hote hi 2 minute mein sab settle ho jaye.
Hisaab itna clear ho ki koi argue hi na kare.
objections: Ek aur app download karna padega? Phone mein already bahut apps hain.
Mere flatmates toh install hi nahi karenge, phir kya fayda?
Splitwise jaisa kuch pehle se hai, ye alag kya karega?
Paise ka matter hai, pata nahi kitna safe hoga.
Kahin baad mein paise toh nahi maangega ye app?
proof_points: Kisi bhi bill ko group ke andar split kar sakte ho.
Group mein sabko dikhta hai ki kaun kitna dena hai.
Payment reminders app apne aap bhej deta hai, tumhe maangna nahi padta.
App ke andar se hi UPI se settle up ho jaata hai.
